96 
 
 
 
 
 
 Plus, Kroenke in the outfield. | Wednesday, September 02, 2026 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 View in browser 
 
 
 
 
 
   
 
 PRESENTED BY PIF 
 
 
   
 
 
 Axios Pro Rata 
 
 
 
 
 By Dan Primack · Sep 02, 2026 
 
 
 🙊 Oops: Last night you got resent Monday's edition of Axios Pro Rata. No, I wasn't just so darned proud of it that I wanted you all to read it again. Tech glitch. Apologies, and hopefully it won't happen again.

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Top of the Morning 
 
 
   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Photo illustration: Brendan Lynch/Axios. Photo: Suzanne Plunkett/Getty Images

 
 
 
   
 
 There is a $100 billion question hanging over the Trump administration's deal to effectively gain control of more than a dozen large oilfields in Venezuela.

 Why it matters: This could become a big opportunity for private equity and private credit, albeit one fraught with pallets of political risk.

 Catch up quick: The U.S. last week struck a deal with Venezuela's government to take control of 17 oil fields with 65 billion barrels of reserves.

 The operator is North American Blue Energy Partners, a closely held company in which the Pentagon taking a 35% equity stake. NABEP is led by controversial Venezuelan oil executive Alejandro Betancourt , who played a role in getting the U.S. comfortable with arresting Nicolás Maduro. In short, it's a public-private partnership with an imperfect partner . Zoom in: NABEP says that its plans "will involve nearly $100 billion in investment to increase production capacity and oil and gas infrastructure in Venezuela."

 But NABEP doesn't seem to have $100 billion, and only has invested $1 billion over the past two years. Thus the apparent opportunity for outside investment — even if the company is telling U.S. officials that it can eventually hit that figure by reinvesting profits as it scales, according to Axios' Marc Caputo . Yes, but: The deal may prove more popular in D.C. than in Caracas — even among Venezuelans who acknowledge that much of the country's oil infrastructure went to pot under Maduro.

 There could be legal challenges in both countries, and this could strengthen the opposition's hand were Venezuela to hold elections that Trump insists he still supports. Plus, there's the broader question about making long-term investments in a company that's de facto controlled by a U.S. administration that will be gone in a few years. The bottom line: Announcing $100 billion in future investment is the easy part.

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 The BFD 
 
 
   
 
 Source: Giphy Stan Kroenke has agreed to acquire the Los Angeles Angels baseball club from Arte Moreno for an MLB-record $4 billion.

 Why it's the BFD: This would make Kroenke the first person to own a team in each major professional sport.

 His other holdings include the NFL's LA Rams, NBA's Denver Nuggets, NHL's Colorado Avalanche, and Premier League's Arsenal F.C. By the numbers: The Angels sale price would top the $3.9 billion that Clearlake Capital's José E. Feliciano recently paid for the San Diego Padres.

 Moreno bought the Angels for just $184 million from the Walt Disney Co. in 2003. The bottom line: This is welcome news for Angels fans. Not only has their team not made the playoffs in over a decade — and not won a playoff series in 17 years — but they've had to watch the (sorta) cross-town LA Dodgers win titles with their former superstar, Shohei Ohtani.

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Venture Capital Deals 
 
 
   
 
 • AfterQuery , an SF-based applied data solutions research lab, raised new funding at a $3.2b valuation, per Forbes. It previously raised $30m in Series A funding at a $300m valuation led by Altos Ventures. axios.link/3T3NQL4 

 • Tripo AI, a generative 3D company, raised $446m in Series B and Series B+ funding. MPCi led, joined by Perfect World, BlueFocus, SPC, Yanqu Games, ThunderSoft, 37 Interactive Entertainment, CDH Venture and Growth Capital, CICC, CMC Capital Partners, Hongtai Aplus, 3H Health, Zhongping Capital, and GreatOrigin Asia. axios.link/4qOnYiN 

 • TabaPay , a Mountain View, Calif.-based provider of money-movement services to fintechs and lenders, raised $155m led by FTV Capital and plans to buy Denver-based Transact Bank , per Axios Pro . axios.link/4qM9IXG 

 • Felix Pago , a money-transfer startup, raised $87m in Series C funding led by a16z and secured a $113m credit line led by General Catalyst 's Customer Value Fund. axios.link/3SsjMbT 

 • Physical Superintelligence , a Cambridge, Mass.-based developer of physical AI labs, raised $58m in seed funding. Breakthrough Energy Ventures led, joined by Dragon Global, Robot Ventures, Solari, Susa Ventures, SV Angel, Valkyrie, Balaji Srinivasan, and Anthony Scaramucci. axios.link/4zRfyes 

 🚑 Typewriter Therapeutics , a developer of re-dosable genetic medicines, raised $56m in Series A funding. AN Venture Partners and RA Capital Management led, joined by ANRI, Gemseki, and SBI US Gateway Fund. axios.link/46lZILH 

 • AIR , an inline firewall for agents, raised $50m. Sequoia Capital and Greenoaks led, joined by Swish Ventures and Netz. axios.link/4cpAkbf 

 🚀 HyImpulse , a German launch services startup, raised €50m in Series A extension funding. Join Capital and Ace Capital Partners led, joined by North Ventures, BW-Capital, Bayern Kapital, German Aerospace Center, and Campus Founders Ventures. axios.link/4r9nvIl 

 • Conveo , a Belgium-founded provider of custom insights for big brands, raised $50m in Series A funding, per Axios Pro . DST Global led, joined by Balderton Capital, Visionaries, and YC. axios.link/4ipWnT5 

 • SciFin , an SF-based revenue data startup, raised $44m in seed funding. Altimeter and Madrona led, joined by Foundation Capital, S32, and Zetta Ventures. axios.link/4ddFyqG 

 • Wafer , an SF-based inference chip startup, raised $40m in Series A funding after spurning acquisition offers. Marathon and Chemistry led, joined by Wing, AMD Ventures, Outset Capital, Fifty Years, and YC. axios.link/4gOYu0h 

 🚑 N-Power Medicine , a Redwood City, Calif.-based cancer drug developer, raised $32m in Series B funding from Labcorp Venture Fund, Merck Global Health Innovation Fund, and Innovatus Capital Partners. axios.link/4cnXwXr 

 • Huskeys , an Israeli cybersecurity startup focused on automated web traffic, raised $27m in Series A funding. Blackstone led, joined by Zscaler and Bright Pixel Capital. axios.link/4cR0aoE 

 ⚡ Odyssey Energy Solutions , a Boulder, Colo.-based platform for financing distributed renewable energy projects in emerging markets, raised $27m in equity funding from Broadscale Group, FMO, Al Mada Ventures, USV, Equal Ventures, Abstract Ventures, Twelve Below, FJ Labs, MCJ, and Transition Ventures. It also secured $47m in debt. axios.link/4zOxmqP 

 • Empirik , an autonomous infrastructure engineer, raised $21m in seed funding from Sequoia Capital, S32, Canapi Ventures, and Alumni Ventures. axios.link/3SrsBTk 

 ⚡️ Gridsight , an Australian developer of capacity management software for utilities, raised US$26m in Series B funding. Insight Partners led, joined by Galvanize, Airtree, Energy Transition Ventures, and Aera VC. axios.link/4xwR9JA 

 • InLeap Photonics , a German developer of laser-based counter-drone tech, raised €20m in seed funding. UVC Partners led, joined by HTGF, Balnord, Sentris, and Scale Capital. axios.link/4iH2K4j 

 • Particula , an Israeli smart toy maker, raised $15m. Elah Fund led, joined by Grove Ventures and Flashpoint. axios.link/4zRr0Xs 

 🚑 Norbert Health , a NYC-based autonomous nursing assistant, raised $14m in Series A funding from Cardinal Group, Exor Seeds, and CareIT. axios.link/4y9Jykc 

 • DataAgent , an Israeli developer of agents that fix cloud infrastructure, closed a $10m pre-seed round led by MizMaa Ventures and Alicorn Venture Partners . axios.link/4qUM8bC 

 • Visko , a Sunnyvale, Calif.-based AI video generation and editing startup, raised $10m in pre-seed funding led by Llama Ventures . axios.link/4i8R9uD 

 • Catch , an Israeli agentic admin assistant, raised $5m in seed funding. Entrée Capital and Pitango led, joined by Seedcamp and Factorial Funds. catchagent.ai 

 ⚡ Ki 13 , a U.K. developer of synthetic fuels, raised $5m in seed funding. HICO Investment Group led, joined by Burgest, Triple Impact Ventures, GiTV and Desai Ventures. axios.link/4gEG8Pm 

 🚑 Scopia Surgical , a Montreal-based developer of surgical navigation solutions, raised C$2.7m in pre-seed funding. Linearis Ventures and Anges Québec led, joined by Fonds Impulsion, Investissement Québec, and HaloHealth. axios.link/461zKNk 

 🚑 Holifya , an Italian digital clinic focused on obesity, raised €1.6m in equity led by Next Age . axios.link/46Grv9r 

 • Instarc , developer of a compliance platform for financial institutions, raised €1.25m led by HFO Investments . axios.link/4xxx2Lr 

 
 
   
 
   
A MESSAGE FROM PIF

 
 PIF delivers strong revenue and profit growth in 2025 
   
 
 
 
   
 
 PIF published its 2025 Annual Report, demonstrating strong performance and progress against its long-term objectives. With a mandate to drive Saudi Arabia’s economic transformation, PIF maintained a diversified portfolio in 2025, balancing returns with national impact and resilience.


 Learn more. 


 
   
 
   
 
 
 Private Equity Deals 
 
 
   
 
 • ALKU , a staffing firm owned by WestView Capital Partners, New Mountain Capital and FFL Partners , agreed to acquire RockITdata , a Philadelphia-based tech consultancy. axios.link/4xsMmJb 

 🚑 Aria Care Partners , a Serent Capital portfolio company, acquired Precision Mobile Care , a Utah-based provider of mobile onsite preventive and restorative dental care. axios.link/4qPejsh 

 • Bain Capital and Lone Star Funds each are prepping second-round bids for Nikkon Holdings (Tokyo: 9071), a Japanese provider of auto supply chain logistics, per Bloomberg. axios.link/4i3eaPF 

 • Blue Sea Capital acquired CompletePet , a Miami-based maker of pet wellness products, from Align Capital Partners . axios.link/3T7lNdG 

 • Citrix , a Vista Equity and Elliott Investment Management portfolio company, completed its acquisition of Numecent , an application virtualization tech company that had raised $15m from Deutsche Telekom, EG Capital Advisors, and ACE Ventures. axios.link/4zNST2G 

 • Foresight Group invested in Distology , a U.K. cybersecurity tech distributor that had been backed by NorthEdge . axios.link/4xDUFlC 

 • KKR agreed to acquire A1 Garage Door ​Service , a Phoenix-based residential garage door repair and replacement company, from Cortec Group for around $2b, per Reuters. axios.link/4cjVrMa 

 🍕 LongRange Capital completed its $2.7b buyout of Pizza Hut , minus the mainland China business, from Yum Brands (NYSE: YUM). axios.link/4iGbWG6 

 ⚡ MacLean Power Systems , a portfolio company of Blackstone and Centerbridge , agreed to acquire Delta Star , a Lynchburg, Va.-based provider of power transformers and mobile substation solutions. axios.link/4h0IdXb 

 • Midland Industries , a Gemspring Capital portfolio company, acquired Pegasus Supply Group , a Noblesville, Ind.-based provider of industrial and electronic connection products. axios.link/4iGPigM 

 • Mutares agreed to buy AmeriTerpenes , a Jacksonville, Fla.-based maker of terpene ingredients, from Germany's Symrise . axios.link/3V76e6i 

 Mutares also completed its acquisition of Trepel , a German maker of airport equipment. axios.link/3Ssrbbc ⚡ Oaktree invested in Vivax-Metrotech , a Santa Clara, Calif.-based maker of locating and inspection devices for utility infrastructure. axios.link/3UlETgD 

 • Permira completed its £2.3b buyout of British fund administrator JTC (LSE: JTC). axios.link/4hRMpHH 

 • Sequoia Financial Group , backed by Kudu Investment Management and Valeas Capital , acquired BSW Wealth Partners , a Boulder, Colo.-based RIA with $2.3b in client assets under management. axios.link/4yeAniz 

 • Valence Surface Technologies , backed by ATL Partners , acquired Cametoid Technologies , a Manchester, Conn.-based provider of ion vapor deposition surface treatments for aerospace and defense. axios.link/4gDVljC 

 🚑 Yellow Wood Partners agreed to acquire Nestlé 's (SWX: NESN) mainstream vitamins, minerals and supplements business for $1b. Axios Pro flashback 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Public Offerings 
 
 
   
 
 🚑 A1Health , a Malaysian hospital chain owned by TPG , filed for a domestic IPO that could raise up to $2.5b, per the WSJ. axios.link/4qZt6Rd 

 ⚡ Hornbeck Offshore Services , a Covington, La.-based provider of marine transport services to the oilfield market, withdrew registration for a $100m IPO after completing a reverse merger with Helix Energy Solutions Group (NYSE: HLX). Hornbeck backers include Ares Management, Whitebox Advisors, and Highbridge Capital Management. axios.link/4ydqD84 

 • RainRock Acquisition , a crypto and web3 SPAC led by Raymond Qu (Geoswift), filed for a $150m IPO. axios.link/4zUf4EI 

 • Three Lions Acquisition , a SPAC formed by Three Lions Capital Management, raised $100m in its IPO. axios.link/442t9Bf 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Liquidity Events 
 
 
   
 
 • Descartes (TSX: TSG) acquired Extensiv , an El Segundo, Calif.-based warehouse management and fulfillment provider, for $120m in cash. It had raised over $140m from firms like Mainsail Partners and FJ Labs (which later sold its stake) . axios.link/4h4Vlul 

 • Lottomatica Group (Milan: LTMC) agreed to buy Madrid-listed gaming and sports betting firm Cirsa Enterprises for around €2.8b in stock. Blackstone is Cirsa's largest shareholder and would hold a 24% stake in the combined company. axios.link/4A6lXTs 

 • New Mountain Capital sold Lincoln Investment , an RIA with around $63b in client assets, back to the Forst family and advisor shareholders. axios.link/46FBags 

 • Palo Alto Networks (Nasdaq: PANW) agreed to acquire Console , an SF-based maker of IT agents that had raised $26m from Thrive Capital, Chapter One, DST Global, SV Angel, and Abstract Ventures. axios.link/4qQDw5G 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 More M&A 
 
 
   
 
 ⚡DNO , a Norwegian oil firm, agreed to buy Capricorn Energy (LSE: CNE) for $396m, beating out Genel Energy. axios.link/4x0y7KE 

 • Keurig Dr Pepper (NYSE: KDP) sold its investment in Chobani back to the ‌yogurt maker for $800m, plus an Allentown, Pa.-based facility for $125m. axios.link/4y6RBhM 

 • Public Storage (NYSE: PSA) closed its $1.2b acquisition of Public Storage Canada . axios.link/4dhcKO7 

 ⚡ Shell (NYSE: SHEL) agreed to acquire the 77% stake it didn't already hold in U.S. convenience store operator Tri Star Energy from Parman and Kimbro Oil . axios.link/4yiv5Th 

 ⚡ SLB (NYSE: SLB) completed its buyout of S&P Global 's (NYSE: SPGI) geoscience and petroleum engineering software portfolio. axios.link/4ydLQPe 

 • Starman Optical , an optical parts maker, agreed to acquire GoPro (Nasdaq: GPRO) for $285m. axios.link/4zLHUH3 

 • WHP Global and G-III Apparel Group (Nasdaq: GIII) completed their $850m acquisition of fashion brand Marc Jacobs from LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton (Milan: MC). axios.link/4dIjXr8 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Fundraising 
 
 
   
 
 • American Industrial Partners plans to target $8b for its ninth fund, up from the $5b it raised for its eighth fund in 2023, per Bloomberg. axios.link/4yjlGeb 

 • Flathead Forge , a Houston-based VC firm focused on hard-tech startups, is raising $200m for its debut fund, per Axios Pro . It also recently hired Chad Bown , former head of Americas at BP Ventures. axios.link/4cnXf6I 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 It's Personnel 
 
 
   
 
 • Younghee Choi joined H.I.G. Capital as head of Asia capital formation. She previously was with Blackstone. axios.link/4xADtxq 

 • Fortress Investment Group named Harry Bush as head of private wealth for EMEA and Yuko Umino as head of private wealth for Japan. axios.link/4x3rbg0 

 
 
   
 
   
 
 
 Final Numbers 
 
 
   
 
 Data: Dealogic; Chart: Emily Peck/Axios Investor fervor for AI is so strong that companies are able to borrow billions of dollars essentially for free, Axios' Emily Peck writes .

 The record surge in zero-coupon convertible bonds is surprising given that we're in a higher rate environment. Typically, that would mean companies would pay higher borrowing costs. 
 
   
 
   
A MESSAGE FROM PIF

 
 PIF delivers strong revenue and profit growth in 2025 
   
 
 
 
   
 
 PIF published its 2025 Annual Report, reporting revenue up 9% to $120 billion and net profit more than doubling to $17 billion, reflecting continued progress against its long-term objectives to drive Saudi Arabia’s economic transformation.
